nominees.name: Eric Barlow

positions.stance: Protect water and electric rates and give communities information; using Wyoming coal and gas to power data centers is 'not a bad thing.'
Colorado River: build an upper-basin coalition with more scientific and legal resources; no federal top-down control.
Calls the Wyoming Business Council an important partner for diversifying the economy; supports the University of Wyoming as valuable.
Wyoming should manage its own grizzly population.
Voted no on a 2020 fuel-tax increase; the claim he sponsored it is false.

policyShifts.shift: Upper-basin coalition posture on the Colorado River.

impediments.title: Freedom Caucus
impediments.detail: The Freedom Caucus took control of the Wyoming House in 2025; Barlow's relation to the caucus was not clear in sources opened.

impediments.title: University budget fights
impediments.detail: A House effort to cut $40 million from University of Wyoming's budget failed in the Senate; Barlow's stance not stated.

insights: Republican-to-Republican handoff from Gordon; the main uncertainty is legislative dynamics with the Freedom Caucus.
Water and energy are the policy anchors.

analysis.summary: A Republican handoff from Gordon; the question is the working relationship with a Freedom Caucus-led House and how much of Gordon's staff stays.
priorities: Colorado River coalition, data centers and rates, economic diversification.
